prompts.idle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: authored 2D game sprite animation sheet. Reference identity: cute golden BREADCRUMB MITE, round pale-yellow body covered in embedded golden/cream crunchy bread chunks, exactly TWO large brown/gold pupils INSIDE cream eye sockets with fierce eyebrows, pink cheek marks, small mouth with TWO curved amber mandibles, EIGHT short jointed golden walking legs with glossy dark-brown pointed tips (natural rear-leg occlusion, no extra legs). Same warm painted crunchy texture/clean dark outline and front three-quarter facing screen-right. Preserve front face, large pale crumb above LEFT eye and crust chunk sides;never mirror. All crumbs stay attached to body. FOUR SMALL complete mites in strict equal TWO rows TWO columns, centers at quarter/three-quarter canvas coordinates, each full silhouette at most30percent CANVAS WIDTH and35percent CANVAS HEIGHT. Broad EMPTY transparent center cross/outer margins, no leg/crumb tip enters adjacent cells. True alpha transparency; no background/haze/groundshadow/text/grid/arrows/motion marks/projectiles/detached crumbs/extra characters. Actual leg-joint and eye articulation, not resized copies. Four idle/blink poses:1 legs planted in low stance, two eyes open and mandibles neutral;2 small mandible/leg settling with eyes open;3 opaque golden lids half-cover BOTH eye sockets, clearly retain cream crescents and brown pupils in BOTH;4 BOTH eyes completely covered by opaque golden lids with short closed seams, NO pupil/cream/highlight visible. Keep round body mass steady.
